_comment: Professor Adow TVET — school-level constants, read by tools/generate-adow-catalog.js and tools/upload-adow-to-bunny.js. This school is hosted by eduplatform but is NOT under Ehel Academy: its own storage zone, its own catalogue, its own consumer record in Moodle. See docs/professor-adow-tvet-setup-plan.md. Phase 0 was completed on 2026-09-25: the zone was created and verified by an authenticated storage read (200, empty), and the pull zone by a root request that reached a Bunny edge. appDomain is a STAND-IN - nothing reads it today, and it becomes the real hostname when a Professor Adow domain is registered.
name: Professor Adow TVET
_storage: Phase 0. The zone is created in the Bunny dashboard; the key is that zone's own password and goes in .env as BUNNY_TVET_KEY — never Ehel's BUNNY_KEY and never Quraan's generic BUNNY_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY.
_departments: Order here is the order departments appear in the catalogue. A department earns a Moodle category only when it has at least one course whose course-manifest.json exists.
